next.reason: 1985: 'If a STOP RUN statement appears in a consecutive sequence of imperative statements within a sentence, it must appear as the last statement in that sequence.' §2023:14.9.42.3 SR1: 'The STOP statement shall be specified only as the last statement in any discreet block of code.' The scope words differ: 2023 drops 'consecutive sequence of imperative statements within a sentence', which the same standard keeps verbatim for GO TO (§2023:14.9.17.3 SR2), for an undefined 'discreet block of code'. Whether STOP RUN may precede a conditional statement in the same sentence (permitted by the 1985 wording) is no longer stated, so the requirement differs; a project reading (docs/CONFORMANCE.md) is not the standard.
